scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Education Of Children Of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Worker must be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB) with at least one year of regular membership.
Children must be studying in Class I to Postgraduate levels.
Students must be enrolled in any institution/school/college located in Haryana.
Self‑employed or employed students are not eligible.
Financial assistance is not given again for the same class if the student fails.
Assistance is limited to up to three female children or two male children per family.
Applicants must upload a certificate from the head of the school/institution confirming regular studies.
benefits_summary: Annual financial assistance of ₹8,000‑₹20,000 per child for education from elementary to postgraduate, with additional one‑time incentives for top performers in Class‑10 exams.
documents_required: Certificate from head of school/institution confirming regular studies
